recentItems.title: Jordanian Interior Minister gives update on deadly church shooting in Karak
recentItems.description:
Senior Jordanian officials have given an update on the investigation into last week's church shooting that left at least eight dead and 40 wounded. 
In a joint press briefing, they said the arrested suspects were members of the same family and acted independently. 
On Monday, security forces arrested three men in connection with the attack.
They were detained after a shootout at a village church south west of the capital Amman. 
A funeral was held on Sunday for the victims of Friday's attack.

recentItems.title: Lula wins Brazil run-off as Bolsonaro refuses to concede defeat
recentItems.description:
Brazil's president Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has won the run-off election, defying predictions.
Runner-up Flavio Bolsonaro has refused to admit defeat and is calling for the result to be annulled. 

Al Jazeera’s Monica Yanakiew reports from Sao Paulo, Brazil.

recentItems.title: Israel's shrinking left as right-wing parties dominate the campaign
recentItems.description:
Israel’s then Prime Minister, Yitzhak Rabin, leader of its Labour Party was proof to many that Israeli left-wing politics was alive, well and willing to offer a two-state solution to end a conflict that had already lasted more than half a century. 

Al Jazeera’s Charles Stratford takes a look at how Israel's left-wing parties have suffered a serious decline in support in recent years.
